snippet.title: New VIRTUA FIGHTER Project - Wolf Hawkfield Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The New VIRTUA FIGHTER Project is on its way!

Following its premiere at EVO Japan 2025, a teaser highlighting Wolf Hawkfield is available now!

#VF #VirtuaFighter #NEWVF #sega
